annotations.title: utilpeek: make a URL slug from text

description: utilpeek: Make a URL slug from text. For other case styles use text_case. Returns a URL slug: accents removed, Latin ligatures, Greek and Cyrillic transliterated, apostrophes dropped and other characters turned into one separator, cut at a separator when over max_length. CJK, Arabic, Hebrew, Indic, Thai and emoji are not romanised: they are dropped and counted in `dropped_characters`. Nothing left to slug is a 422 empty_slug (not charged). Typically under 0.1 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/slug-generator-api.html

max_length.description: Longest slug (1-200, default 80); cut at a separator.
max_length.title: Max Length

name: make_slug

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
